activities.main_competence: 1.0 Use applied mathematical knowledge and skills
activities.specific_competence: 1.1. Use some advanced skills in geometry, trigonometry, and vectors to solve problems in different contexts
activities.learning_activity: Explore some advanced tenets of trigonometry (relationship of the secant, cosecant, and cotangent to the sine, cosine, and tangent, trigonometric identities: Pythagorean, compound and double angles)
suggested_methods: Exploration: Guide students through geometrical drawings, measurements, graphs and geometrical animations to explore the basic tenets of trigonometry
activities.assessment_criteria: Some advanced tenets of trigonometry are well explored

activities.main_competence: 1.0 Use applied mathematical knowledge and skills
activities.specific_competence: 1.2 Use functions and calculus to solve problems in different contexts
activities.learning_activity: (a) Explore some advanced tenets of functions (Properties, Domain and Range and graphs of cubic functions, rational functions with a constant numerator and a linear equation in the denominator, logarithmic, and exponential functions)
suggested_methods: Jig Saw: In groups assign students with a different types of functions to explore its tenets through concrete examples, graphs and function simulations and share the results through presentations
activities.assessment_criteria: Some advanced tenets of functions are well explored
suggested_resources: Mathematical software such as MATLAB, Maple, Mathematica

activities.main_competence: 1.0 Use applied mathematical knowledge and skills
activities.specific_competence: 1.2 Use functions and calculus to solve problems in different contexts
activities.learning_activity: (b) Solve real life problems involving growth and decay
suggested_methods: Scenario: Provide scenarios that shows the applications of algebra in solving growth and decay problems. Allow students to discuss, make follow up and provide feedback
activities.assessment_criteria: Real life problems involving growth and decay are well solved
suggested_resources: Mathematical software such as Maple, GeoGebra, MATLAB, and Mathematica

activities.main_competence: 1.0 Use applied mathematical knowledge and skills
activities.specific_competence: 1.2 Use functions and calculus to solve problems in different contexts
activities.learning_activity: (c) Exp lore the basic tenets of calculus (Differentiation: first principles, power rule, chain rule, product rule, and quotient rule, Integration: substitution method)
suggested_methods: Group discussion: Organise students in groups to investigate the tenets of calculus through the use of Calculus books and technological tools
activities.assessment_criteria: Basic tenets of calculus are well explored
suggested_resources: Mathematical software such as Maple, GeoGebra, MATLAB, and AI tools

activities.main_competence: 1.0 Use applied mathematical knowledge and skills
activities.specific_competence: 1.2 Use functions and calculus to solve problems in different contexts
activities.learning_activity: (d) Use differentiation methods to solve real life problems (maximum and minimum, curve sketching, rate of change
suggested_methods: Exploration: Guide students to solve real world problems and model them using tenets of differentiation through relevant books, ICT tools.
Drill and practice: Guide students to perform several tasks on applications of differentiation in real life situations
activities.assessment_criteria: Uses of differentiation methods are well discussed

activities.main_competence: 1.0 Use applied mathematical knowledge and skills
activities.specific_competence: 1.2 Use functions and calculus to solve problems in different contexts
activities.learning_activity: (e) Use integration methods to solve real life problems (area under the curve, volume of solid of revolution, cost and revenue functions)
suggested_methods: Problem solving: Individually or in groups, allow students to model and solve scenarios that reflects the application of integration in real life
activities.assessment_criteria: Integration methods in solving real life problems are well discussed

activities.main_competence: 2.0 Use algebra, set theory, and logic to solve problems in different contexts
activities.specific_competence: 2.1 Apply knowledge of sequences and series in different contexts
activities.learning_activity: Use sequences and series to determine simple and compound interest
suggested_methods: Exploration: Organise students to explore the basic tenets of sequence and series
Guest speaker: Invite a guest speaker to guide students towards understanding on the applications of sequence and series in determining simple and compound interest
Scenario: Provide a scenario that shows the applications of sequences and series in solving problems related to simple and compound interest
activities.assessment_criteria: Sequences and series are used appropriately to determine simple and compound interest

activities.main_competence: 2.0 Use algebra, set theory, and logic to solve problems in different contexts
activities.specific_competence: 2.2 Apply knowledge of algebra and number theory in different contexts
activities.learning_activity: Explore some advanced tenets of algebra (solve simultaneous equations of one linear and one quadratic equation algebraically and
suggested_methods: Questions and answers: Assign students questions on algebra tenets and allow them to find answers through discussions, consulting relevant books and ICT tools and share their findings
Group discussion: Organise students in groups and provide practice tasks on finding solutions of simultaneous equations algebraically and graphically
activities.assessment_criteria: Some advanced tenets of algebra are well explored
suggested_resources: Mathematical software such as Maple, GeoGebra, MATLAB, and AI tools

activities.main_competence: 1.0   Use applied mathematical knowledge and skills
activities.specific_competence: 1.1   Use some advanced skills in geometry, trigonometry, and vectors to solve problems in different contexts
activities.learning_activity: (a) Explore some advanced tenets of coordinate geometry (area of a triangle, angle between two lines and perpendicular distance from a point to a line)
suggested_methods: Discovery method: Allow students to contextualize coordinate geometry into everyday life and explore its tenets by hypothesizing, experiment, justify findings and share their conclusions.
Drill and practice: Guide students to perform several tasks on the tenets of coordinate geometry
activities.assessment_criteria: Some advanced tenets of Coordinate geometry are well explored

activities.main_competence: 1.0   Use applied mathematical knowledge and skills
activities.specific_competence: 1.1   Use some advanced skills in geometry, trigonometry, and vectors to solve problems in different contexts
activities.learning_activity: (b) Explore some advanced tenets of vectors (unit vector, scalar product, cross product, angle between two vectors and work done by a constant force, derivative and integration of vector functions)
suggested_methods: Group discussion: Allow students to work in groups to relate vectors in everyday life and explore its tenets through visual representations, manipulatives, technological tools and reporting of findings
Questions and answers: Equip students with suitable vector materials, assign them questions and allow them to present their findings
activities.assessment_criteria: Some advanced tenets of vector is well explored

activities.main_competence: 1.0   Use applied mathematical knowledge and skills
activities.specific_competence: 1.2 Use statistics to solve problems in different contexts
activities.learning_activity: Explore some advanced tenets of statistics (measure of central tendency and dispersion: calculate mean by the coding method, variance, standard deviation, quartiles, and percentiles)
suggested_methods: Study tour: Organise a study tour and allow students to collect data from a visited organisation. Guide them to explore some basic tenets of statistics and allow them to present their findings
Questions and answers: Assign statistics questions and allow students to present and discuss their findings
activities.assessment_criteria: Some advanced tenets of statistics are well explored

activities.main_competence: 2.0   Use algebra, set theory and logic to solve problems in different contexts
activities.specific_competence: 2.1 Use set theory and logic in argumentation and decision making
activities.learning_activity: (a) Explore advanced tenets of set theory (operations involving three sets and cardinality of a set)
suggested_methods: Questions and answers: Equip students with sets materials, prepare questions for students to perform and present their findings.
Group discussion: Organise students in groups and provide practice tasks on sets
activities.assessment_criteria: Advanced tenets of set theory are well explored

activities.main_competence: 2.0   Use algebra, set theory and logic to solve problems in different contexts
activities.specific_competence: 2.1 Use set theory and logic in argumentation and decision making
activities.learning_activity: (b) Explore the basic tenets of logic (statements, connectives, truth table, arguments involving three propositions, electrical networks involving three propositions)
suggested_methods: Logic games: Guide students towards logic puzzles, games, and other iterative activities to enable learners understand the basic logic concepts
activities.assessment_criteria: Basic tenets of logic are well explored

activities.main_competence: 2.0   Use algebra, set theory and logic to solve problems in different contexts
activities.specific_competence: 2.1 Use set theory and logic in argumentation and decision making
activities.learning_activity: (c) Use logic to analyse validity of arguments
suggested_methods: Questions and answers: Equip students with suitable logic materials, prepare questions for students to perform, ask students to present their findings.
activities.assessment_criteria: Logic is used correctly to analyze the validity of arguments
